ambient_events: A door goes somewhere up the stairwell and the whole frontage takes a moment to settle.
Somebody's extractor fan starts up behind a kitchen window and carries the smell of frying onions out over the street.
The stair light flickers, holds, and goes back to burning steady.
A bin bag is lowered on a rope from a third-floor window to a waiting hand.
description: Four storeys of soot-black brick with a stone name band over the door reading FILAMENT BUILDINGS A.D. and then a year that has been chiselled out. Every window is a different age: some original sash, some aluminium, one boarded and painted over so often the board has a moulding. The stair light burns behind the fanlight day and night, because it is on the street circuit and nobody has ever found the switch.
name: Filament Buildings
